remediation.issue: The rendered-page read executes a scraper with a supplied landing URL.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before the fetch, accept only http and https URLs, and pass the URL as a structured argument rather than through a shell string.

remediation.issue: The skill can request pages that may be outside the user's control.
remediation.suggestion: State that users must have authorization to assess the destination and avoid fetching private, loopback, link-local, or internal network addresses.

content.user_title: Preflight Your Landing Page Before Launch
content.value_statement: Paid campaigns can lose relevance when the ad promise does not match the landing page. This skill checks the visitor experience and provides a clear pass, partial, or fix list.
actual_capabilities: Compares ad headlines and offers with the landing-page message.
Checks whether the offer and primary call to action appear above the fold.
Reviews available page-speed data and labels estimates clearly.
Counts required form fields and identifies specific friction points.
Checks mobile visibility, readability, tap targets, and horizontal scrolling.
Routes each confirmed gap to the appropriate follow-up skill.
limitations: It does not rewrite copy, redesign layouts, or modify forms.
It does not calculate Quality Score or make a launch decision.
Speed and mobile findings are estimates when no measured data is supplied.
It needs destination-page content and ad copy to assess message continuity.

use_cases.title: Launch a paid campaign
use_cases.description: Check that new search or social ads deliver the promise shown on the destination page before launch.

use_cases.title: Investigate weak landing experience
use_cases.description: Identify likely message, speed, form, or mobile gaps when an advertising platform reports low landing-page experience.

use_cases.title: Prepare a page handoff
use_cases.description: Create a specific repair list for copy, design, or offer owners without asking the checker to redesign the page.

prompt_templates.title: Basic page preflight
prompt_templates.prompt: Preflight https://example.com against these ad headlines: Fast setup, transparent pricing. Flag message-match gaps before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Quality Score check
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a landing-page experience preflight for https://example.com. Check the above-fold offer, form friction, speed evidence, and mobile experience.

prompt_templates.title: Compare live offer wording
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these ads and this landing-page copy. Mark each message-match issue Pass, Partial, or Fix, and identify the exact missing promise.

prompt_templates.title: Campaign readiness handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Preflight https://example.com for a direct-response campaign using these headlines and offer terms. Produce a five-check punch list with measured versus estimated labels and one owner for every Fix.

output_examples.input: Preflight a page whose ad promises a 20 percent discount, but the page shows no discount above the fold.
output: Message match: Fix — the advertised 20 percent discount is absent.
Above the fold: Fix — show the offer and primary call to action without scrolling.
Handoff: Send offer wording to the landing-page owner.

output_examples.input: Review a page with matching ad copy, two required form fields, and no speed export.
output: Message match: Pass — headline and offer match the ad.
Form friction: Pass — two required fields are identified.
Speed: Estimated — request a page-speed export for a measured result.

best_practices: Provide the exact live ad copy and the destination URL or pasted page copy.
State whether speed and mobile evidence is measured, user-provided, or estimated.
Confirm authorization before fetching or assessing a live destination page.
anti_patterns: Do not request a continuity verdict without both ad and page content.
Do not treat estimated speed observations as measured performance data.
Do not ask this skill to redesign the page or calculate Quality Score.

faq.question: What does this skill check?
faq.answer: It checks message match, above-the-fold content, speed evidence, form friction, and mobile rendering.

faq.question: Do I need to provide ad copy?
faq.answer: Yes. Exact headlines, hooks, and offer terms are needed for a reliable message-match review.

faq.question: Can it measure page speed?
faq.answer: It uses supplied page-speed data when available. Otherwise, it labels observations as estimates.

faq.question: Does it redesign the landing page?
faq.answer: No. It reports specific gaps and routes repair work to the appropriate owner or skill.

faq.question: Does it calculate Google Quality Score?
faq.answer: No. It identifies landing-page experience factors that can affect relevance.

faq.question: Can it check any public URL?
faq.answer: Only assess pages you are authorized to review. Confirm before fetching a live page.
